PLL ADS — LIVE PERFORMANCE (net-new only: Contract Manufacturing + White Label Samples)

WINDOWS
- Today 2026-07-21 (PRELIMINARY)
- Trailing 7: 2026-07-14 to 07-20
- Prior 7: 2026-07-07 to 07-13 (campaigns did not exist; $0 baseline; serving began 07-20)

TOTALS
- Today: $26.62 | 94 impressions | 12 clicks | 12.8% CTR | $2.22 CPC | UNDER $30 cap
- Trailing 7: $31.72 | 122 impressions | 16 clicks | 13.1% CTR | $1.98 CPC
- Prior 7: $0 — a clean from-zero baseline, not a trend

CAMPAIGNS TODAY
- Contract Manufacturing: $22.16 | 88 impressions | 9 clicks | 10.2% CTR | $2.46 CPC
- White Label Samples: $4.46 | 6 impressions | 3 clicks | 50.0% CTR | $1.49 CPC

AD GROUPS, 7/20–7/21
- Cosmetic-Beauty: 138 impressions | 11 clicks | $27.06 — top spend
- Samples: 13 impressions | 7 clicks | $10.41 — best CTR, approximately 54%
- Skincare: 19 impressions | 4 clicks | $8.39
- Haircare: 43 impressions | 3 clicks | $7.39; 7/21 had 14 impressions and 0 clicks — watch
- BeardOil: 2 impressions | 2 clicks | $3.38
- HairOil: 1 impression | 1 click | $1.71
All seven ad groups and both campaigns are enabled.

LEADS — UNATTRIBUTED
- Today: 1 external form lead (Edythe, skincare)
- Trailing 7: 3 external form leads, excluding 1 internal test
- Prior 7: 1 external form lead
No UTM/GCLID is captured and ads only began serving 7/20, so none can honestly be claimed as ad-sourced.

NOT YET MEASURABLE: booked calls, paid sample purchases, CPL, or cost per booked call. Google conversions show 0 because the configured conversion is chat/call, not form fills. Search-term mining is blocked by the reporting-tool gap and fewer than 50 clicks. Today is under the $30 cap; 7/20 reached $31.72 through Google intraday overdelivery. Forms are reaching the inbox and landing URLs are live, but paid-to-lead attribution is missing.

Recommendation requiring Sam’s approval: add UTM parameters and GCLID auto-tagging to the net-new ad URLs, plus a hidden source field on the contact form. This changes live final URLs but adds $0 spend and unlocks reliable CPL measurement.
spoken_text: Bottom line: your two new campaigns are live, running clean, and under the thirty-dollar cap. Today they spent twenty-six dollars and sixty-two cents for twelve clicks, with a healthy twelve-point-eight percent click-through rate and a two-dollar-and-twenty-two-cent cost per click. The prior seven-day figure was zero because these campaigns only started serving July twentieth, so this is a fresh baseline, not a trend yet. You had one form lead today and several over the past week, but I cannot honestly credit them to ads because the form has no tracking tag, so booked calls and cost per lead are not yet measurable. In plain English, early efficiency looks promising, but volume is tiny and we are flying blind on which leads paid ads produced. I recommend adding UTM and click-ID tracking to the ad links plus a hidden source field on the form; it costs no extra spend, but I need your approval because it changes live ad URLs.
